title: No Experience Challenge
description: This mod adds a new challenge to the game by killing you when you pick up experience. The challenge is inspired by the german YouTuber BastiGHG
body:
# No Experience Challenge
## Explanation
This mod brings a new challenge to minecraft. Do you think you can play through minecraft without ever picking up experience. Single Experience points not levels are counted. The mod starts instantly when a world is created
## Difficulties
You can either play with infinite lifes or with one life. You can change that with /gamerule oneLife [true/false].
## Technical Things
The mod is required both server- and clientside
